summary: UnrealIRCd is an advanced and modular IRC server written in C that operates on Linux, BSD, Windows, and macOS. It allows you to host your own real-time text communication networks with a high degree of configuration.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you want to run a traditional, customisable Internet Relay Chat network on your own infrastructure.
watchOut: You will need to manage server configuration manually, and setting up advanced module integrations requires familiarity with C-based server environments.
deployNotes: As a compiled C application, it typically requires persistent storage for configuration and log files, along with proper port configuration for network traffic.
